text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Through relentless effort and giving it 
our all, we were able to achieve the best 
possible result.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"This is all because of the efforts we 
made together, Trainer—"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"However, the other runners ran a 
fantastic race as well. If even one step 
had been different, who knows how it would 
have turned out..."
choice_data_list:
You should celebrate the victory right in 
front of you for now.

Let's get ready for the next one right 
away!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ah... You are quite right. Perhaps the 
excitement of the race still lingered— I 
got ahead of myself.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
First, I shall savor this victory 
alongside Trainer, who has run with me 
every step of the way...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And so, let us dash forward toward the 
next stage once more.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I would like to review today's race 
and properly grasp the results.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I can hardly wait for the next race. 
No matter how formidable the opponent, I 
will surely prevail.
